scene: public EPIC-KITCHENS P03_28 egocentric bottle workspace

actions.label: handover-bottle
actions.instruction: Starting with the blue bottle held in the right robot hand, bring it to the center, transfer it into the left robot hand, separate the hands, and hold the bottle only in the left hand.

phases.name: present
phases.description: preserve the right-hand grasp and bring the upright blue bottle to the center while the left hand opens

phases.name: dual-contact
phases.description: close the left fingers around the bottle while the right hand keeps contact

phases.name: transfer
phases.description: release the right fingers only after the left-hand grasp is established

phases.name: separate
phases.description: move the empty right hand away while the left hand holds the bottle

phases.name: display
phases.description: hold the bottle visibly in only the left hand

actions.label: unscrew-bottle-cap
actions.instruction: Starting with the blue bottle held in the right robot hand, stabilize the bottle body, twist the cap counterclockwise with the left gripper, lift the separated cap, and hold the open-bottle display pose.

phases.name: stabilize
phases.description: preserve the initial right-hand bottle grasp

phases.name: center-bottle
phases.description: bring the upright blue bottle to the center without releasing it

phases.name: grasp-cap
phases.description: close the left gripper on the cap while the right gripper stabilizes the bottle body

phases.name: unscrew
phases.description: rotate the left wrist counterclockwise without rotating the bottle body

phases.name: remove-cap
phases.description: lift the separated cap while the right gripper holds the open bottle

phases.name: display
phases.description: display the open bottle in the right hand and cap in the left

phases.name: hold-terminal-state
phases.description: hold the accepted separated-cap terminal frame without interpolation

actions.label: rinse-bottle
actions.instruction: Starting with the blue bottle held in the right robot hand, move it under the faucet, use the left robot hand to operate the faucet, orient the bottle for rinsing, and hold the rinsing pose.

phases.name: stabilize
phases.description: preserve the initial right-hand bottle grasp

phases.name: move-under-faucet
phases.description: move the bottle directly below the visible faucet

phases.name: operate-faucet
phases.description: reach the faucet control with the left gripper

phases.name: orient-for-rinse
phases.description: orient the bottle beneath the faucet while keeping the right-hand grasp

phases.name: hold-terminal-state
phases.description: hold the accepted rinsing pose without interpolation
